question: Which of the following is a good way to organise files in Windows?

options.text: Store all files on the desktop
Create separate folders for different types of files
Keep files with different subjects in one folder
Rename all files with random numbers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Create separate folders for different types of files**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Organizing files into separate folders for different types of files helps maintain clarity and makes it easier to locate specific files when needed.
 
• This method enhances productivity by reducing the time spent searching for files.
